looki.plugin.title: Looki
looki.plugin.summary: Connects to the official open API of the Looki wearable camera: each day's moments (when, where, what you were doing) become materials, and are looked up on the spot when you ask "what was I doing yesterday afternoon"
looki.plugin.purge.records: Moments and AI journals imported from Looki (the records)
looki.plugin.purge.key: The Looki API key you entered
looki.plugin.keep.materials: Materials made from them: materials belong to the core — to delete them, use bulk delete in Memory · Materials, or before removing, disconnect Looki in Settings · Data sources and choose "Delete what was imported too"
looki.plugin.keep.chat: The chat turns that looked up Looki (the moments found, Ergo's replies)
looki.plugin.keep.backup: The copy in backup snapshots (goes away as snapshots rotate: about 7 days locally, up to about 5 weeks in the sync folder)
looki.source.title: Looki
looki.source.summary: Each day's moments from the wearable camera (time, place, title and description) become materials; AI journals are only searchable; photos and videos aren't imported
looki.tool.title: Look up Looki
looki.error.key: Looki doesn't accept this API key (deleted, expired, or the wrong region)
looki.error.rateLimit: Looki is rate limiting (at most 60 requests a minute per key): try again in a minute
looki.error.server: Something went wrong on Looki's side (HTTP {status}): try again later
looki.problem.key: Looki no longer accepts the saved API key (deleted or expired): create a new one in Looki Web and enter it below
looki.problem.rateLimit: Looki is rate limiting (at most 60 a minute): sync or look things up again in a minute
looki.problem.rateLimitWaiting: Looki is rate limiting (at most 60 a minute): the sync will carry on in a moment
looki.configure.badRegion: The region can only be China or International
looki.configure.noKey: Enter an API key first (create it under API keys in Looki Web; it starts with lk-)
looki.configure.badKey: The API key can't contain spaces or line breaks: check you didn't copy too much
looki.configure.keyRefused: Looki doesn't accept this key: check it's copied in full and the region is right (China and International keys don't work across regions)
looki.configure.keptOld: The new key didn't pass ({reason}); still using the old one
looki.plugin.purge.archiveIndex: The "Keep a local copy" settings and records (what has been saved); the saved photos, journals and vlogs themselves stay
looki.plugin.keep.archive: Photos, journals and vlogs saved locally (by default in the Looki folder under Documents): that's your own archive, delete it in the folder yourself if you want
looki.archive.problem.diskFull: Disk full: the drive holding {dir} is out of space, so saving stopped. Free up space and tap "Continue now", or wait for the next sync
looki.archive.problem.noPermission: No permission to write {path}: saving stopped. Pick another folder or allow writing to this one
looki.archive.problem.notFolder: {path} isn't a folder, can't write there: pick another one
looki.archive.problem.noFolder: No folder chosen yet: enter one below
looki.archive.problem.insideDataDir: Can't save inside Ergo's data folder (it would end up in backups): pick another folder
looki.archive.problem.noDefaultParent: The folder above the default location isn't there ({dir}): pick another folder, or create that one first
looki.archive.problem.rateLimit: Looki rate-limited us before saving finished: the next sync continues
looki.archive.problem.api: Saving didn't finish ({reason}): the next sync continues
looki.archive.refused.notAbsolute: Enter a full path, e.g. D:\Looki
looki.archive.refused.notConnected: Connect Looki first (enter the API key above)
looki.archive.refused.off: Turn on "Keep a local copy" first
looki.archive.refused.busy: Already catching up: stop it before starting again
looki.archive.refused.badRange: Write dates like 2026-10-01; the start can't be after the end, and the end can be yesterday at the latest
looki.archive.refused.tooLong: At most {days} days at a time
looki.archive.disconnectNote: Photos, journals and vlogs saved locally ({folder}) are not deleted: that's your own archive, delete them in the folder yourself if you want
looki.archive.journal.heading: {date} · {title}
looki.archive.journal.byline: Journal written by Looki's AI · recorded at {time}
looki.archive.readme.title: {date} ({weekday}) · Looki
looki.archive.readme.noMoments: No moments saved for this day.
looki.archive.readme.pending: (not all saved yet, the next sync continues)
looki.archive.readme.failed: (couldn't be saved after several tries; tap "Continue now" in Settings · Data sources to retry)
looki.archive.readme.footer: Ergo saved this folder from Looki automatically and updates this note on every sync. Photos and videos are the original files (time taken, place and other details are inside them); each file's modified time is when it was taken.
